sentences.text: The Crime and Corruption Commission established Taskforce Flaxton to examine corruption risks in Queensland prisons and identify reforms.
sentences.support: commenced Taskforce Flaxton to identify corruption and risks of corruption in Queensland prisons

sentences.text: The inquiry examined prison operations, the rules governing them and ways to prevent and respond to corruption.
sentences.support: features of the legislative, policy and operational environment that may enable corrupt conduct to occur

sentences.text: The CCC found that overcrowding increased corruption risks and considered the existing prison anti-corruption framework ineffective.
sentences.support: Prison overcrowding is negatively affecting the way prisons operate and increasing corruption risk.

sentences.text: Its 33 recommendations addressed Queensland Corrective Services performance and external oversight.
sentences.support: We have made 33 recommendations that seek to improve the performance of QCS and the external oversight mechanisms.

findings.quote: The CCC found that unique features of the prison environment create corruption risk.
The CCC is of the view that alleviating prison overcrowding is essential to reducing corruption risk and corruption in Queensland prisons.
